title: Authentic Pasta Making Experience in Niagara
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Alcoholic Beverage (18+ older), Allergen Alert, and Dietary Food restrictions applies (please advise us in advance).

We happily accommodate vegetarian and vegan diets, as well as gluten-free guests for the meal (please note that we do not teach gluten-free pasta making during the hands-on class). Guests must notify us of all allergies and dietary restrictions upon registration.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Escape the typical Niagara tourist crowds for a genuine slice of Italian culture. Hosted in our intimate Pasta Studio by a passionate Chef and Sommelier duo, this hands-on experience is backed by four decades of family culinary tradition. It's an authentic, engaging escape that perfectly blends time-honored Italian pasta making with local Niagara charm.
